title: LibWeb/CSS: Insert required comments when serializing lists of tokens
task_prompt: Fix the failing test Tests/LibWeb/Text/input/wpt-import/css/css-syntax/serialize-consecutive-tokens.html. When serializing a list of CSS tokens, required whitespace or comment separators between certain adjacent token pairs are not being inserted. This causes parse-and-serialize roundtrips to produce invalid or ambiguous CSS — for example, two consecutive ident tokens serialize without a separator, making them parse as a single token on re-parse. The expected output is in Tests/LibWeb/Text/expected/wpt-import/css/css-syntax/serialize-consecutive-tokens.txt.
